duplicados.bajada: Profiles that look like the same person. Spotted by normalised URL, handle and name similarity. They are never merged on their own.
duplicados.borrarBajada: It is deleted from the database and cannot be undone. It is safe because they took part in no campaign: there is no history to lose. {sobrevive} is left alone.
duplicados.descartarBajada: They are marked as reviewed and leave this list. Nothing is deleted or merged: you are only saying they are not the same person.
duplicados.descartarTitulo: {cantidad, plural, one {Dismiss the pair} other {Dismiss # pairs}}
duplicados.fusionBajada: Everything from {absorbido} moves to {sobrevive}: profiles, niches, tags and campaigns. {absorbido} is archived with a note saying who it was merged into. Nothing is deleted.
duplicados.fusionConflictos: {cantidad} were not moved: they were already in that campaign
duplicados.fusionarBajada: Only the ones that are the same account are merged: same URL or same handle on the same network. In each pair the card with more history (profiles and campaigns) is kept and the other is archived with a note saying who it was merged into — nothing is deleted. The ones that were paired only because the names look alike are left alone, and we tell you which they are so you can look at them one by one.
duplicados.fusionarConfirmar: Merge the ones that are the same account

scouting.aQuienBuscasAyuda: A topic and a network. Everything you filter is checked against the data the network returns: if a creator is missing the datum, it is flagged, not discarded.

scouting.avisoAudiencia: Before you use these: today the provider has audience demographics almost only for the United States. Measured on 2026-08-27: there are 110,177 Argentine creators between 10k and 100k, but asking in addition that their audience be Argentine leaves 9. For clients here it is better to leave these on “does not matter” and filter by the creator’s country, above.
scouting.bajada: Find new people through an outside provider. It costs per record, so we always tell you what it will come to before running it. Before spending, look in Discovered: that is already paid for.
